crossRefs.note: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”
David said to Abigail, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!
Now while Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before God’s house, there was gathered…
From that time forth, half of my servants did the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, the bows, and…
For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:

translations.web: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
translations.bsb: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you.” Nor can the head say to the feet, “I do not need you.”
translations.kjv: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
translations.asv: And the eye cannot say to the hand, I have no need of thee: or again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
